source_findings: Native Codex clones the nonnull response.usage JSON delivered to it into completion usage metadata, then separately converts typed counters. This preserves delivered JSON, not necessarily original provider JSON.

RawResponseCompleted has response identity, typed usage and optional metadata. Persisted TokenUsageRecord has per-response and cumulative scopes; rollout persistence excludes RawResponseCompleted. Cumulative snapshots must not be added to per-response usage.

A native internal experimental app-server exposure exists in source: experimentalRawEvents gates rawResponse/completed with thread, turn, response identity, typed usage and cloned metadata. No activation or observed Harbor CLI carrier is established.

OmniRoute sanitizes before completed-event normalization. The normalizer uses Number and missing-value fallbacks; observed client integer descriptors alone cannot establish original provider presence, types or absence of estimates.

The native Responses collector clones usage at ingest, but finalize selects completedSnapshot or latestSnapshot and then picked.usage or earlier usage or null. It can synthesize IDs/status and retains output and metadata. A summary containing usage is not a body-free original-terminal witness.

Collector live reduction before storage caps supports a conditional native pre-sanitation boundary; executed path, terminal provenance, actual attempt identity and custody still require observation. Logging enabled and raw chunks disabled do not establish these predicates.
